title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Azusa, an overworked office worker, dies and is reborn as an immortal witch who wants nothing more than a quiet rural life. After 300 years of casually killing slimes near her house, she discovers she has reached the maximum level, and the fame that follows brings a stream of visitors who end up living with her: dragon girls, slime-born daughters, a demon and others. The manga adapts a light novel and centres on her growing found family and efforts to keep life lazy (Yen Press blurb; MU Family, Adopted Child/ren, Village/s).
life_message: A slow, kind life with a family you gather yourself is worth more than power or status.
